rasa.dominant: adbhuta braced by vīra (wonder with resolve)
rasa.justification: Wonder at the dream-mapped states, the wondering yogin, the virgin power — braced by the resolve implied: states are for traversing, not inhabiting.

sections.BOUNDARY: No practice is given; states are mapped, not yet traversed.
sections.EXPLANATION: Dream, constructs. Non-discernment, māyā, deep sleep. Three-triad enjoyer, hero-lord. Wonder, yoga-stages. Will, power, Umā maiden. Seen, body. Pure-reality joining, or beast-power — two fates.
sections.FUNCTION: Maps the states: dream, sleep, triad-enjoyer, wonder, will, seen-body, two fates.
sections.KEY TERMS: svapna (dream — constructs); sauṣupta (deep sleep — non-discernment); vīreśa (hero-lord of the triad); vismaya (wonder — itself the stages); Umā Kumārī (virgin power); dṛśya-śarīra (seen as body); apaśu-śakti (beast-power — the alternative).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: States mapped here are traversed in freedom and initiation beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: Dream, constructs. Non-discernment, māyā, deep sleep. Three-triad enjoyer, hero-lord. Wonder, yoga-stages. Will, power, Umā, maiden. Seen, body. Pure-reality joining, or beast-power.
